title: Tensor-Hom transposition of local scalar multiples
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A,H,F$ modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\iota:A\to\mathcal O_X$, $U$ an open, $s\in\mathcal Hom(H,F)(U)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and $\alpha:A\to\mathcal Hom(H,F)$ such that $\alpha_W(a)=\iota_W(a)s|_W$ for every open $W\subseteq U$. If $\beta:A\otimes H\to F$ has the tensor-Hom evaluation formula $\beta_W(a\otimes g)=\alpha_W(a)_W(g)$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-hom-adjunction], then $\beta|_U$ is multiplication via $\iota$ followed by the local morphism represented by $s$, transported through overFunctorEquiv.

source.place: Tag 01YB (coherent-lemma-homs-over-open), structure-module case and internal-Hom/tensor-Hom paragraphs before the kernel argument.

proof.text: Precompose both sides with the inverse restriction tensor comparison isomorphism. Tensor-bilinear uniqueness reduces equality to pure tensors of local sections of the restricted modules.

For an open V of U, put W=U inclusion image V. The comparison sends the local pure tensor to the ambient pure tensor on W. Apply the evaluation and scalar-value hypotheses. Unfold the internal-Hom scalar action and restriction to obtain the scalar iota(a) times the evaluation of s on W.

Whiskering iota and applying the left unitor sends the pure tensor to iota(a) times g. The overFunctorEquiv components and overEquiv mapped morphism evaluate to s at W. Linearity of s equates these expressions.

theorem tensorHom_restriction_of_local_scalar
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (A H F : X.Modules)
    (ι : A ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) H F).val.obj (op U))
    (α : A ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) H F)
    (hα : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U) (a : A.val.obj (op W)),
      α.val.app (op W) a = ι.val.app (op W) a •
        (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) H F).val.map (homOfLE h).op s) :
    letI : MonoidalCategory X.Modules := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    ∀ (β : A ⊗ H ⟶ F),
      (∀ (W : X.Opens) (a : A.val.obj (op W)) (g : H.val.obj (op W)),
        β.val.app (op W)
          ((SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A H).inv.val.app (op W)
            (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction.{u}
              (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app (A.val ⊗ H.val)).app (op W)
                (a ⊗ₜ[X.sheaf.obj.obj (op W)] g))) =
          (α.val.app (op W) a).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) g) →
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).map β =
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).map (ι ▷ H ≫ (λ_ H).hom) ≫
          (overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app H ≫
          (overEquiv U).functor.map (⟨s⟩ : H.over U ⟶ F.over U) ≫
          (overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app F
